G1.title: Worker bao READY khi khong sync, ghi snapshot that bai; retry/recovery chua bao dam
G1.resolution: Propagated disk write failure with SYNC_FAILED. Set status BLOCKED when syncToken is missing (no false READY). Implemented startup recovery (@EventListener(ApplicationReadyEvent.class)) for orphaned SYNCING snapshots. Added manual retry POST /api/admin/catalog/snapshots/{id}/retry and max retry count limit (5). Activated scheduling with @EnableScheduling in SchedulingConfig. Strict HTTP Ack validation checking status ('success', 'OK', 'SYNCED', 'UNCHANGED'), exact generation, and content hash; handled SKIPPED as STALE_SKIPPED. Enforced DB unique constraint on catalog_snapshots (snapshot_version).
tests: Spring Boot Startup Recovery and Scheduled Polling

G2.title: Sync cu van ghi de snapshot moi; generation/hash khong rang buoc noi dung
G2.resolution: Implemented atomic Compare-And-Swap (CAS) in FastAPI sync_index protected by _publish_lock. Verified caller's declared content_hash against computed canonical hash (HTTP 400 on mismatch). Same generation with different content returns HTTP 409 Conflict; same generation with identical content returns status: UNCHANGED. Replaced active index atomically via pointer swap after building candidate. Persisted sync state to data/indices/catalog_sync_state.json and restored on startup. Safely accessed locks and attributes using globals().get() and getattr().

G3.title: Rebuild index khong loai bo document/embedding cu
G3.resolution: HybridMovieIndex.build_from_catalog resets self.documents and self.embeddings before loading candidate items, cleanly handling empty catalog [] by emptying the corpus. BM25.fit() clears dictionary statistics (doc_len, avg_doc_len, doc_freqs, idf) unconditionally prior to corpus size validation.

G4.title: Public search van tra draft; snapshot/public DTO chua loc het quan he
G4.resolution: Applied strict deny-by-default publication policy in isPublished (requiring record.status == 'ready'). Cascaded publication check across series, seasons, episodes, segments, and scenes in CatalogQueryService.searchCatalog, getSeriesDetail, and getEpisodeDetail. In exportEligibleSnapshot, made exports strictly self-contained: pruned text tracks to eligible asset IDs, filtered characters to those referenced in eligible entities, and excluded private/disabled assets and dangling references.

G5.title: storage_key route moi bypass Drive executor/deadline/cleanup; private responses van public-cacheable
G5.resolution: Enhanced StorageKeyConfig path containment to verify real path across all ancestor symlinks and junctions via toRealPath(). Routed Drive storage_key assets through DriveMediaStorageAdapter bounded methods (getResourceForPath, getResourceLengthForPath, openChannelForPath) with DriveIoExecutor timeouts, circuit breaker, and DriveSeekableByteChannel. Enforced conditional Cache-Control: 'public, max-age=3600' for public assets and 'private, no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate' for non-public (authenticated / private) assets across HEAD, GET, and Range byte responses.
tests: MediaStreamController HEAD and GET Cache-Control headers

G6.title: Bang chung gate chua du; repro cu co gia dinh khong con dung
G6.resolution: Verified and passed all gates: Frontend npx tsc --noEmit passed (0 errors), npm run build passed with all 8 routes optimized. Full Maven test suite passed 15/15 tests (CatalogValidatorTest, CatalogImportServiceTest). Full FastAPI test suite passed 12/12 tests in 141s. Probe docs/reviews/repro/CATALOG_01_F02_probe.py passed 100%. Contract validation passed on both example and blank. Enhanced frontend player with generation check (pending.generation === playGenRef.current), mediaAssetId validation with warning banner, coverageJson logical-to-file timestamp conversion (resolveFileTimestamp), segment seek support, and preview state payload hash binding with retry button in Admin UI.
tests: frontend npm run build (0 errors, 8 routes)

P1_admin_import.details: Admin login -> Upload JSON -> Dry-run preview with diff counters & JSON Pointer errors -> Bind preview state to payload hash -> Atomic 12-table import -> Outbox snapshot status monitoring with real-time badges (READY, SYNCING, PENDING, BLOCKED, SYNC_FAILED) and manual retry capability calling POST /api/admin/catalog/snapshots/{id}/retry.

P2_player_playback.details: HTML5 player streaming Drive video via Media Service -> Strict identity tuple (seriesId, episodeId, assetId, generation) -> Prevent seeking on wrong asset when scene.mediaAssetId is unlinked -> Convert logical segment/scene time to file timestamp via coverageJson -> Reset pending seek on unmount and episode change.

P3_search_retrieval.details: Multi-tier search across series, episodes, segments, and scenes -> Cascaded publication filter -> Deep links with full parameters (?episode=...&scene=...&asset=...&t=...) -> AI CineBot grounded discovery using genuine catalog entities.

P4_restart_stability.details: Startup recovery for orphaned SYNCING snapshots on ApplicationReadyEvent -> FastAPI sync state persisted in data/indices/catalog_sync_state.json and restored on launch -> Monotonic generation uniqueness enforced by DB constraint.
